adrs.title: Selection of Modular Layered Architecture for AquaSense
adrs.context: Project structure spans 4 functional boundaries with distinct responsibility separation.
adrs.decision: Enforce clean layered boundaries between presentation, domain services, compute engine, and storage.
adrs.consequences: Maintains low coupling and allows individual components to be unit tested in isolation.

adrs.title: Integration of Python 3 + Numpy for High-Throughput Processing
adrs.context: Codebase leverages Python 3, Numpy, Scipy, Pandas as primary ecosystem dependencies.
adrs.decision: Standardize async execution and typed contract models across all internal module interfaces.
adrs.consequences: Ensures sub-millisecond serialization latency and predictable runtime performance.

rules.description: Presentation and API layers must not import private database models directly without a service boundary.
Core calculation engine must remain pure and free from direct network or disk side-effects.
External client calls must route through adapter classes to handle offline degradation.
No cyclic dependencies permitted across functional subsystems.
